title: Draft: generic: IPv4: Out-of-order detection by 2 methods [#17392]
description:
Both "normal" and perfectly reversed fragment orders are considered
"in-order". Any ordering that is neither are marked using expert info
"warning" messages.

Generic changes, but only active on IPv4 packets, where preference
provided to enable or disable the feature.

This branch also includes a local implementation in packet-ip.c - appreciate comments on whether to include changes ONLY in packet-ip.c or if there would be other ways to implement this generically.  I would not expect to include both, but this branch shows both for easier review.

Reversed version of example pcap added to #17392

Fixes: #17392

AI-Assisted: no
